summary: `no-schema-type-mismatch` now flags `properties` on any non-object type and `items` on any non-array type. **This can fail specs that passed before**, because the rule is an error in `recommended`.
`generate-spec` gains `--openapi-version` to choose 3.1 or 3.2 (default). Fixes `recheck --fix` reporting.
Generated TypeScript clients get an `onSettled` middleware hook, and `generate-client` gains a `client.telemetry` option.
